column1: Combine the marmalade, BBQ sauce, and soy sauce in a large skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until thick and smooth, 15–20 minutes.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Whisk the eggs and milk in one bowl and mix the flour and seasoning in another.
Coat the chicken in the egg mixture, let the excess drip off, then dredge each piece well in the flour.
Pan-fry in hot oil over medium heat until golden, 3–4 minutes per side.
Add the sauce to the chicken and heat through. Serve with rice.
